protagonist.role: Grandfather of two (ages 2 and 1), head of a 3-generation 6-person rural household
protagonist.location: Rural village in Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam

house_facts.footprint: 5m wide x 15m long (approx. 16.4ft x 49.2ft, ~800 sq ft per floor)
household_members: Uncle Dinh (50) — sleeps on a simple wooden bed tucked into the ground-floor alcove beneath the wooden staircase
Wife — sleeps upstairs in Bedroom 2 with 1-year-old grandson Khoi
Daughter & Son-in-law — sleep upstairs in Bedroom 1 with the 2-year-old grandson
verified_home_details: Folding metal street gate opening onto a rural village lane under yellow streetlights
Living room with carved wooden chairs, blue folding hammock, and red plastic toy basket
Family kitchen with speckled granite counter, wooden upper cabinets, Toshiba fridge, baby formula tin, and green rice cooker
White powder-coated steel baby gate anchored to the round carved wooden stair post with a woven olive-green nylon strap
house_facts.neighborhood: 50 meters from the village morning market and 80-year-old mother-in-law's house

target_audience_us.primary_demographics: US viewers aged 35-75+ (especially 50-75+ retirees/pre-retirees watching on Smart TV & iPad)
core_personas: Margaret & Robert (62-74, suburban US retirees seeking calm, authentic family warmth, and practical resourcefulness)
David & Helen (45-60, working professionals decompressing from screen fatigue and high US living costs)
target_audience_us.emotional_tone: Dignified, warm, grounded, observant, practical, WITHOUT bitterness, self-pity, or begging
